name: clipisode/_qr-bundle-anchor
title: Clipisode QR bundle anchor (do not register)
description: Placeholder block.json that exists ONLY to opt this folder into the wp-scripts auto-build pipeline. Nothing in PHP calls register_block_type() for this name — its sole purpose is to point wp-scripts at view.ts so we get a built build/qr/view.js that ships the qrcode npm package as a window.clipisodeQr global. Used by the desktop intro screen to render the phone-handoff QR locally instead of via api.qrserver.com.
